correctness.rationale: The sparse-sphere pointwise distance is established with sharp support-wise lower bounds and explicit attainability. Exact ball dilation yields the positive-part distance. Rearrangement and convexity of a one-variable endpoint function prove the uniform all-n,k,lambda formula, sharp threshold, and all positive-defect deep holes. All boundary indices and parameters are covered. The bundled independently structured exact-rational verifier passed 980 point-distance grids and 140 phase checks; finite tests are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Gives exact continuous Hausdorff convexification rates and sharp finite saturation for all skeleta of the canonical cross-polytope in all dimensions, with a nontrivial change of deep-hole topology at 2(k+1)=n. This supplies an explicit natural benchmark for recent qualitative finite convexification theories and illuminates distinct obstructions from the center versus outer uniform-coordinate boundary, not an arbitrary finite special case.
